scope: Eight canonical sources supporting 2025 US family-office research; no corpus-wide inference. Seven retain unknown date bounds. This is date routing review, not a renewed substantive or professional review.

rows.decision: The published rule states August 29, 2011 as its effective date. Open end means no end recorded; later amendments are not established.
Selected sections span the 2004 chapter and 2013 amendments. No single effective date for all indexed passages is established.

rows.locator: PDF p.1, edition and Purpose of Schedule K-1
rows.decision: 2025 instruction edition routes partner reporting. The year label and December 17, 2025 publication date do not establish one effective window for every indexed tax provision.
Covers calendar 2025, fiscal years beginning in 2025 and ending in 2026, plus conditional short-year 2026 use. No entity-independent complete date window is established.

rows.locator: PDF p.1, Purpose of Form; beneficiaries reporting estate or trust items
rows.decision: The 2025 beneficiary instruction edition does not establish the estate or trust fiscal period or a single effective date for each tax provision.
2025 publication covers decedent, estate and beneficiary reporting; death date, tax period and provision-specific changes require context. Publication edition is not an effective date.

rows.locator: F. Period Covered by the Tax Return
rows.decision: Covers calendar 2025 or fiscal years beginning in 2025 and conditional short-year 2026 use. A January-to-December bound would omit supported fiscal-year use.
